data.title: 黍 · 金黄稻浪旁的炊烟夜话
data.action: 侧坐在田埂边的木回廊上，单手扶着竹编斗笠，脚踝垂在田水上方轻晃，绿意龙角间缠着稻穗，温柔大姐姐的眼眸含笑看着归家的博士。
data.location: 大荒城外的水田木栈道，四周是沉甸甸垂头的金黄稻浪，远山泛着炊烟暮霭
data.lighting: 落日熔金的橙黄夕阳铺满天际，将稻田与神性龙角镀上一层丰收的璀璨金晖
data.mood: 大地母亲般的无限包容与农家丰收的温暖眷恋，恬淡而治愈
data.description: 大荒城外的水田木栈道，四周是沉甸甸垂头的金黄稻浪，远山泛着炊烟暮霭。侧坐在田埂边的木回廊上，单手扶着竹编斗笠，脚踝垂在田水上方轻晃，绿意龙角间缠着稻穗，温柔大姐姐的眼眸含笑看着归家的博士。 她微微抬眸轻语——“博士，奔波了一整天，肚子也饿了吧？灶上正焖着今年的新米饭……今晚就好好歇在长姐身边吧。”
data.promptProse: Seated leisurely along the wooden walkway overlooking sprawling golden rice paddies outside Dahuang at dusk, Shu wears a warm wheat-yellow linen wrap robe with grain embroidery layered loosely over a jade-green tube top. Resting one hand on her woven bamboo hat while dangling her bare feet above the shallow paddy water, she smiles toward the viewer with warm elder-sisterly grace. Molten golden sunset light washes over the swaying rice stalks and distant misty hills.
data.animaCaption: Seated barefoot on the wooden paddy walkway in her open wheat-yellow linen wrap robe over a jade tube top, Shu rests one hand on her bamboo hat and smiles warmly toward the viewer. Golden sunset light stretches across the ripe rice fields and distant mountains.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a warm wheat-yellow rustic linen wrap robe embroidered with golden grain tassels draped loosely over a jade-green tube top, barefoot above the paddy water.
